title: Gionatan Nese — a portfolio as a slowly turning cloud of objects
note: The home page has no scroll and no headline: about 25 small cutouts (product renders, logos, posters on #F0F0F0 tiles) float on a sphere in the middle of a white screen, with the name in a grotesk on the far left and the role in a serif on the far right, both 14px on the centre line. Everything else is a 15px nav of frosted pills at the top. Built in Next.js with GSAP and one fullscreen Three.js r184 canvas; the DOM only holds an sr-only copy of the content for SEO. Worth reusing: the restraint. Tiny type, pure #000 on #fff, and the work shown as small objects rather than big hero images.
